page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, with the running head "BIBLICUS." and page number 155 at the top. Below the text, after a centred "XVII." and the heading "ARCHITECTONICA SACRA.", come two numbered theses (I, II), and the second ends with the word-break "Opor-". Line-count numbers in the left margin and the music staves at the left edge (show-through from the facing page) are not transcribed.

main_text.p: que hæc causa fuit, quòd in cultu legali adhibita fuerunt diuersa organa: vt admonerentur non in aliis rebus frivolis & ineptis, vt mundus facere solet, sed in celebratione beneficiorum Dei oblectationes animorum esse quærendas, atque huc studium omne esse referendum Psal. 148. Et quemadmodum sunt varia Dei beneficia: sic nostrum est subinde nova & varij generis carmina con-dere, & concinere, tum voce, tum organis, in laudem & honorem Dei, & domi, & in templo, & in campo.

Neque vero hoc modo paedagogia & infantia veteris populi veluti postliminio introducitur. Non enim apparatum Leuiticæ musicæ in templa nostra inuehimus, sed quantum excitandis animis satis est adhiberi volumus. Coloss.3.v.16. Deinde musica debet seruire moderatæ hilaritati, & profligandæ melancholiæ. 1. Sam. 16.v.16.23. Denique harmonia musica debet nobis in memoriam redigere harmoniam illam mundi, quæ cernitur inter cœlum & elementa, inter facultates animæ, inter corpus & animam, inter qualitates corporis: item egregiam illam harmoniam, quæ fuit in homine, & inter hominem atq; reliquas creaturas ante lapsum, quæque erit in altera vita. Vide quæ sub finem Poeticæ differuimus ex Athanasio de utilitate numerorum poëticorum. Uno verbo: Musica & harmonia, quæ cernitur in cantilenis, organis musicis, & vocibus auicularum musicarum, nos admonere debet de harmonia precum & virtutum.
main_text.head: ARCHITECTONICA SACRA.
main_text.p: I. ARchitectonica sacra est bene ædificandi scientia ex S. literis illustrata.
II. Eius partes duæ sunt: prima, de affectionibus, altera, de exemplari operis extruendi. Opor-

page.notes: Initial "A" of thesis I is a large ornamental letter, joined to "Rchitectonica" as "ARchitectonica". The "ARCHITECTONICA" heading has an ornamental initial, transcribed as plain "A". "Coloss." is printed with a ß-type ligature, transcribed as "Coloss.". The "poëticorum" in the Athanasius reference is slightly smudged but readable. Left-margin music staves are show-through from the facing page and are excluded.
